description: State Representative Eric Roberts went to the Capitol with one job in mind: to serve the people of House District 83. Find out more about his key priorities and accomplishments in just his first term in office, serving neighbors living in Edmond, Nichols Hills, The Village, and part of Oklahoma City, Oklahoma.
